worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.summary: Stand still and send a low shadow crawling along the ground in the aimed direction; it stops at the first solid wall. The first enemy that steps onto the shadow is stabbed from its rear. It no longer drags or slows, cannot pierce walls, and is still the cheapest and fastest first strike in its family.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.0: The cheapest opener, pre-empting the target
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.1: Crawl a short shadow along the ground and stab the first enemy in the way
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.2: Strike first around nearby terrain edges (it stops at solid walls)
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.descriptio: The shadow blade strikes the first enemy that steps onto it from behind for about %1$s physical damage; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

The shadow reaches about %1$s blocks along the ground, crawling at %2$s blocks/tick with a hit radius of about %3$s blocks; it only catches the first enemy that steps onto it and stops at solid walls.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.0: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.1: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.preference: It reaches for targets within this distance; the shadow reaches much further than a punch, so larger values mean opening from further out.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this stab; off: it ranks as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
On: prefer targets whose attention is on someone else (their back to the caster), which reads as a strike from behind; off: ignore facing.
